headline: Google Executive Donald Harrison Resigns from SpaceX Board After Decade
summary: SpaceX disclosed that Google executive Donald Harrison resigned from its board of directors after more than a decade, with the resignation taking effect immediately.
why: Board departures at high-profile private aerospace and technology firms can signal shifts in strategic alignment among major corporate stakeholders.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc
impacts.why: Resignation of a senior executive from an external board role.
